title: Pinecone Labs - Dedicated cluster networking + streaming behavior
next_steps: Redwood to send recommended ALB idle timeout and streaming keepalive guidance
Customer to test with idle_timeout=300s and report back
Redwood to consider heartbeat chunks during tool execution
transcript:
Meeting: Pinecone Labs - Dedicated cluster networking + streaming behavior
Recorded: 2025-12-09 15:00 UTC
Duration: 41 minutes
Attendees: Aisha Rahman, Hiro Tanaka, Maya Srinivasan, Jordan Miles, Sana Qureshi

Summary
- Customer seeing streaming chat cut off around 2 minutes on long requests in eu-west.
- Suspect ALB idle timeout + lack of streaming chunks during tool execution.

Transcript
[00:00] Aisha Rahman: Cool, thanks everyone. We saw the note about streaming timeouts. Can you describe exactly what you're seeing?
[00:28] Jordan Miles: Yeah, so we call the chat completions streaming true. It starts fine, and then like if a tool call runs or the model just thinks a long time, we get like no data, and at about two minutes it just closes the connection.
[01:05] Sana Qureshi: Our load balancer is AWS ALB. I think default idle is 60, but we set it to 120. It's pretty consistent around 120 seconds.
[02:02] Hiro Tanaka: That does sound like ALB idle. When we're in tool execution, right now we don't emit any chunks until we resume generation. So if it pauses longer than the idle timeout, ALB will terminate.
[03:11] Jordan Miles: So the stream is 'alive' but silent, which looks like a hang from the client side.
[04:20] Maya Srinivasan: Exactly. The app just sits there waiting and then bam, EOF.
[06:05] Aisha Rahman: Two possible mitigations: increase idle timeout, or we send keepalive chunks. Do you have constraints changing the ALB settings?
[07:02] Sana Qureshi: We can set it higher, 300 is fine. We just didn't know it was needed for streaming.
[09:18] Hiro Tanaka: We'll send you a doc snippet. Also we're tracking adding a heartbeat event like a ping every 15 seconds if blocked on tools.
[12:44] Jordan Miles: That would solve it without needing high idle time.
[18:30] Aisha Rahman: Great. We'll follow up by email with exact recommended settings.
[40:10] Aisha Rahman: Recap: you'll test with 300s idle timeout, we'll consider keepalive chunks and share guidance.
